title: CI, build, tooling and git/train hygiene

questions.text: What exact command does CI run, and can I run it locally on the merged tree (base + my branch)?
Which exported symbols or contracts does my change touch, and who calls them?
Is every new component (infra, service, workflow, dependency) named in the request? If not, have I asked?
Which actions are irreversible or outward (push, merge, force, admin, delete, billing)? Do I have explicit approval for each?
What is my build budget (typecheck time, peak RSS, deploy machine memory), and what is the baseline?
What will I create (worktrees, branches, servers, caches), and when will I delete it?
Which external dependencies (CI minutes, deploy provider, quota, keys) must be up, and how do I see they are?
What is the merge queue length and service rate right now, and what wakes me when it changes?
Where does the platform expect this artifact to live (skills, env files, configs), per its docs?
Pre-mortem: it is a week later and this broke the integration branch. Why?

budgets.measure: trains dropped because of this branch / trains it boarded
budgets.source: Not Rocket Science Rule; merge queues

budgets.measure: peak private bytes of the build tree (mem_map / heavy_capped log)

rules.title: Conflict marker committed
rules.why: The file no longer parses, or both sides ship half each.
rules.confirm: static-proof: the marker line is in the tree
rules.fixHint: resolve the hunk by reading both sides (git show :2:path / :3:path)

rules.title: Blanket -X ours/theirs or checkout --ours/--theirs over many files
rules.why: Every conflicting hunk is resolved unread; exports, imports and catalog keys disappear silently.
rules.confirm: static-proof: the option is in a script; train merged-tree check finds lost keys or exports
rules.fixHint: resolve conflicts file by file; union only for append-only files

rules.title: Hooks or required checks bypassed (--no-verify, HUSKY=0, SKIP_HOOKS, gh pr merge --admin)
rules.why: The check that would have caught the break never runs.
rules.confirm: static-proof: the flag is in a script or workflow

rules.title: Exported signature changed with fewer callers updated than a search finds
rules.why: Another package or adapter breaks at runtime or in the train.
rules.confirm: failing-test: workspace typecheck or the caller's test fails on the merged tree

rules.title: New Dockerfile, runner, workflow or service not named in the request
rules.why: Somebody now owns and pays for a thing nobody asked for.
rules.confirm: repro-script: quote the request; the component is not in it

rules.title: OOM 'fixed' by raising --max-old-space-size without a profile
rules.why: The real growth stays; the next build OOMs on a bigger machine.
rules.confirm: measurement: --extendedDiagnostics or trace shows the hot file

rules.title: READY/done with no command, exit code and SHA attached
rules.why: The train bounces and the owner re-checks by hand.
rules.confirm: repro-script: run the CI command on the stated SHA; it fails

rules.title: A check whose failure cannot fail the job (continue-on-error, || true, ; exit 0)
rules.why: A red check that cannot fail becomes a baseline everyone learns to ignore, and new reds hide in it.
rules.confirm: repro-script: make the check fail; the job still exits 0
rules.fixHint: fix or quarantine the failing case by name with an owner and a date

verify.text: gate on the merged tree: rebase, format check, lint, typecheck, tests; record exit codes + SHA
git diff --check and the conflict-marker scan return nothing
dependents' tests ran; workspace typecheck green
Types / Check time / Memory from --extendedDiagnostics and build peak vs baseline
any unexplained error reproduced from a clean tree on the same SHA before a code change
worktrees, branches and servers I started are gone
